title: The Margin of the Command
statement: A rigid city strip and poster-mark act as the instruction already given. A flamingo and flower cross their measured field, making interpretation visible as the vivid, living deviation that follows.

actions.statement: A rigid city strip and poster-mark act as the instruction already given. A flamingo and flower cross their measured field, making interpretation visible as the vivid, living deviation that follows.

notes.note: The initial collage has a strong command-field but needs a lower threshold and a connective organic stroke. I’ll introduce the surf crowd as a collective horizon behind the figures, then extend the botanical material downward behind the flamingo so the flower becomes an act of interpretation rather than an isolated label.

The collage now reads as a staged threshold: architectural order and the repeated M frame an unruly, embodied answer. I’ll add a small, attentive human portrait in the upper dark field as the interpreter—the point where an instruction becomes a lived decision—then inspect the final balance.

The visual argument is complete, but the flower’s rectangular white paper edge reads as an unintentional block. I’ll trim that fragment to its blossom-and-stem silhouette, strengthening the contrast between imposed frames and organic interpretation.
